name: Gamma-valerolactone
aliases: 4-hydroxypentanoic acid lactone, 4-hydroxyvaleric acid lactone, 4-methyl-4-hydroxybutanoic acid lactone, 4-methyl-g-butyrolactone, 4-methyl-gamma-butyrolactone, 4-pentanolide, 4-valerolactone, 5-methyloxolan-2-one
summary: γ-Valerolactone (GVL) or gamma-valerolactone is an organic compound with the formula C5H8O2. This colourless liquid is one of the more common lactones. GVL is chiral but is usually used as the racemate. It is readily obtained from cellulosic biomass and is a potential fuel and green solvent.

pharmacology.text: GVL behaves as a prodrug to γ-hydroxyvaleric acid (GHV), a drug with similar effects to those of γ-hydroxybutyric acid (GHB), albeit with less potency in comparison.

uses.text: GVL is chiral but is usually used as the racemate.

summaryZh: γ-戊內酯是一種內酯類有機化合物，化學式C5H8O2，常溫常壓下為無色液體，以外消旋混合物的形式存在，很容易從纖維素等生物質中獲得，是一種潛在的燃料和綠色溶劑，還能作為生產γ-羥基戊酸的前體物質。
summaryZhHans: γ-戊内酯是一种内酯类有机化合物，化学式C5H8O2，常温常压下为无色液体，以外消旋混合物的形式存在，很容易从纤维素等生物质中获得，是一种潜在的燃料和绿色溶剂，还能作为生产γ-羟基戊酸的前体物质。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because the body turns it into GHV, a weaker GHB-like drug, it may cause drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting and, at high amounts, loss of consciousness.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。由於身體會把它轉化為作用較弱、類似 GHB 的 GHV，它可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、噁心、嘔吐，量大時可能失去意識。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。由于身体会把它转化为作用较弱、类似 GHB 的 GHV，它可能造成嗜睡、头晕、恶心、呕吐，量大时可能失去意识。

fact.en: GVL can be made from plant waste such as wood and straw, and it is being studied as a greener solvent and fuel additive. It also has a sweet, herbal smell and is used as a flavouring.
fact.zh: Γ-戊內酯可以用木材、稻草等植物廢料製造，正被研究作為較環保的溶劑和燃料添加物。它帶有甜甜的草本香氣，也被用作調味香料。
fact.zhHans: Γ-戊内酯可以用木材、稻草等植物废料制造，正被研究作为较环保的溶剂和燃料添加物。它带有甜甜的草本香气，也被用作调味香料。
